objections.reason: The draft renders liberation as "libertação" (T241, T351, T220); "liberação" is inconsistent, and T351 has the same English "definite liberation".

objections.reason: Tibetan sa is bhūmi, rendered "estágio" in T155; "nível" is inconsistent for the same term.

objections.sense: level of the children of the Victors
objections.reason: Tibetan sa is bhūmi, rendered "fase" in the children's field in T155; "nível" is inconsistent.
Same Tibetan thar ba and English "liberation" as T241, which uses "libertação"; "liberação" is inconsistent.
"Vigilância" is the rendering of saṃprajanya (T047); apramāda (bag yod) is "cuidado atento" in T121, so the chapter title must match.
Same concept as T165 (hell guardian), whose children rendering is "guarda do inferno"; the two should match.
Children's rendering of śīla is "boa conduta" in T094; "bom comportamento" is inconsistent.
T322 (same god) uses "Brahma" in the children's field, matching the transliteration pattern of other names (Manjushri, Mara); "Bramá" is inconsistent.
"lazer" means recreation, not the freedom to practise (dal ba); consistent with the proposed "liberdade" for kṣaṇa (T221) and T195.
"Montes" evokes mountains and differs from the academic "Três Acúmulos"; both fields should render 'heaps' alike.
"perversidade" means wickedness or cruelty in Portuguese; viparyaya/phyin ci log means a distorted or inverted view, not malice.
